description: This file defines a wizard interface for creating payment orders based on account move lines, including form definitions, search and creation functions, and a wizard class with states.

classes.name: wizard_payment_order
classes.description: A wizard interface class for handling payment order creation with states for initialization, search, and creation.

methods.name: search_entries
methods.description: Searches for account move lines to pay based on due date and populates a form with the results.

methods.name: create_payment
methods.description: Creates payment line entries for selected move lines according to user preferences.
